question: True or false: grinding espresso finer always extracts more of the coffee into the cup?
answer: False. Past a point, very fine grounds pack so tightly that water forces a few fast channels through the puck and bypasses the rest. A 2020 study combining modelling with brewing found finer grinds lowered extraction and made shots erratic; less coffee, ground coarser, gave far more reproducible shots. Water takes the easy road.
move: Past a certain point, more of the right thing starts to block itself.
trap: Reasoning that smaller particles expose more surface, so they must extract more.
